messages:
Alex Kim: ok team — quick sync on promptset merging for the quant bakeoff. we have three domain pools (support, search, copywriting) + synth augment. want to align on negative controls and oversample rules.
Mira Patel: sounds good. my high-level: preserve domain ratios but upweight rare edge intents x4, keep ~2.5k calibration total.
Jordan Lee: +1. for quant comparisons we need consistent prefix lengths. flagging that copywriting prompts skew long (>=512 tokens).
Sam Rivera: can we do stratified holdouts by domain+length bucket? e.g., short <64, mid 64-256, long 256+. then sample per bucket.
Olivia Zhang: agreed. also we should add a "semantic-dup" dedupe pass so paraphrases across pools don't leak. simple sim threshold at 0.88.
Alex Kim: proposal: pipeline steps -> normalize -> dedupe(sim0.88) -> assign domain+length bucket -> upweight edgecases -> sample fixed per-bucket quotas -> append negative controls. @mira @jordan
Mira Patel: that works. negative controls: mix of hallucination prompts, instruction-contradictions, and label-flip pairs. target ~10% negatives.
Jordan Lee: for label flips, keep ground-truth and a flipped label variant. those are good regressions detectors for quant.
Sam Rivera: nit: make sure negatives don't blow distribution — we need calibration to reflect production. maybe cap negatives per domain at 12%.
Olivia Zhang: human-in-loop: we'll send a ~500 subset to SME review to weed ambiguous anchors. prioritize long+edgecases.
Alex Kim: here's a quick sampling command I ran locally (bash):
```
python scripts/sample_calib.py \
  --pools support.json,search.json,copy.json,synth.json \
  --dedupe-threshold 0.88 \
  --buckets "0-63,64-255,256-1024" \
  --edge-upweight 4 \
  --negatives 0.10 \
  --seed 42 \
  --out picks/205321
```
Mira Patel: thanks. can you also output a small metadata CSV with columns: id,src,domain,length_bucket,edge_flag,negative_flag? that'll make stratified evals easier.
Alex Kim: yup, script already emits metadata.csv. sample row: `12345,search,search,64-255,1,0`.
Jordan Lee: on sampling quotas: propose 800 short, 1200 mid, 500 long (total 2500) + 250 negatives = 2750. numbers tuned for per-token budget.
Sam Rivera: ok, but remember FP8/INT8 runs will be sensitive to long tails — maybe increase long to 700 and drop mid by 200.
Olivia Zhang: I support more long prompts for coverage. long are where quant errors concentrate.
Mira Patel: fine, final quotas: short 800, mid 1000, long 700 -> 2500; negatives 250 distributed across buckets.
Alex Kim: noted. next: edgecase definition — using failure logs + fuzzing hits + manual tagging. combine signals and call edge_flag if any.
Sam Rivera: add an uncertainty score from the baseline float model (entropy > 3.5) as another edge signal.
Jordan Lee: good idea. will add to enrichment step.
ci-bot: sampling job queued: job-id=calib-205321-3 status=queued.
Olivia Zhang: review plan: once picks/metadata.csv is ready, i'll coordinate SME review thread for the 500 subset. please cc me.
Alex Kim: timeline: finalize pipeline by EOD tomorrow, produce full sample and SME subset by end of week. any blockers?
Mira Patel: none from my side. will prepare negative control templates.
Sam Rivera: i'll run dedupe pass and sanity-check token length histogram.
Jordan Lee: i'll wire the entropy enrichment.
Alex Kim: perfect. thanks all :rocket:
